$comment: Machine-readable description of the migrated schema. Verified against PostgreSQL by dictionary.integration.test.ts; data-dictionary.md is generated by the Docker Compose docs service.

tables.name: users
tables.description: Every person who signs in: employees raising tickets, technicians and administrators. Also holds the Argon2id credential and the JWT revocation counter (SD-013).

columns.name: user_id
columns.meaning: Primary key.

columns.name: email
columns.meaning: Login identity, stored lowercase (CHECK) and unique.

columns.name: display_name
columns.meaning: Name shown in audit history and ticket screens; nonblank.

columns.name: role
columns.meaning: EMPLOYEE, TECHNICIAN or ADMIN; drives authorization.

columns.name: is_active
columns.meaning: FALSE deactivates the account without deleting history.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: When the account was created (UTC).

columns.name: password_hash
columns.meaning: Argon2id PHC string (salt and parameters embedded); NULL until a credential is provisioned, which blocks login. Never plaintext, never returned by the API.

columns.name: token_version
columns.meaning: Carried in every JWT. Incrementing it invalidates all of the user’s outstanding tokens (stateless revocation).

tables.name: support_teams
tables.description: Technician groups that tickets are routed to.

columns.name: team_id
columns.meaning: Primary key.

columns.name: name
columns.meaning: Unique nonblank team name.

columns.name: description
columns.meaning: Optional description of the team's responsibilities.

columns.name: is_active
columns.meaning: FALSE retires a team; old tickets keep their link.

tables.name: team_members
tables.description: Membership of users in support teams (many-to-many). Its key is the target of the tickets assignee composite FK.

columns.name: team_id
columns.meaning: Part of the primary key; the team.

columns.name: user_id
columns.meaning: Part of the primary key; the member.

columns.name: joined_at
columns.meaning: When the user joined the team.

tables.name: ticket_categories
tables.description: Approved categories used for triage, knowledge articles and evaluation labels.

columns.name: category_id
columns.meaning: Primary key.

columns.name: name
columns.meaning: Unique nonblank category name.

columns.name: description
columns.meaning: Optional description.

columns.name: is_active
columns.meaning: FALSE retires a category without changing history.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Creation time (UTC).

tables.name: tickets
tables.description: The support request and its technician-approved routing. AI proposals are stored separately in ai_recommendations.

columns.name: ticket_id
columns.meaning: Primary key and tracking identifier.

columns.name: requester_id
columns.meaning: Employee who raised the ticket.

columns.name: assigned_team_id
columns.meaning: Approved team; NULL until a technician routes the ticket.

columns.name: assignee_id
columns.meaning: Approved technician; must belong to assigned_team_id (composite FK); NULL when unassigned.

columns.name: category_id
columns.meaning: Approved category; NULL until triaged.

columns.name: title
columns.meaning: Short summary (max 150), nonblank.

columns.name: description
columns.meaning: Problem details, nonblank.

columns.name: status
columns.meaning: OPEN, TRIAGED, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED or CLOSED.

columns.name: priority
columns.meaning: UNSET, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH or CRITICAL; approved by a technician.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Submission time (UTC).

columns.name: updated_at
columns.meaning: Last mutation time, set by the service.

columns.name: resolved_at
columns.meaning: Latest resolution time; NULL unless RESOLVED/CLOSED; cleared on reopen.

columns.name: resolution_summary
columns.meaning: Latest resolution text; required when RESOLVED/CLOSED; cleared on reopen.

columns.name: version
columns.meaning: Optimistic concurrency token; incremented by every mutation, checked by writers.

columns.name: idempotency_key
columns.meaning: Optional client key (Idempotency-Key header); unique per requester so a retried submission returns the original ticket.

columns.name: first_response_at
columns.meaning: Posting time of the first public comment by a technician or administrator other than the requester; NULL until then. Stable: set with the comment, never cleared.

checks.name: ck_tickets_assignee_requires_team
checks.rule: ((assignee_id IS NULL) OR (assigned_team_id IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: ck_tickets_no_stale_resolution
checks.rule: (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['RESOLVED'::character varying, 'CLOSED'::character varying])::text[])) OR ((resolved_at IS NULL) AND (resolution_summary IS NULL)))

checks.name: ck_tickets_priority
checks.rule: ((priority)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['UNSET'::character varying, 'LOW'::character varying, 'MEDIUM'::character varying, 'HIGH'::character varying, 'CRITICAL'::character varying])::text[]))

checks.name: ck_tickets_resolution_required
checks.rule: (((status)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['RESOLVED'::character varying, 'CLOSED'::character varying])::text[])) OR ((resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (resolution_summary IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(resolution_summary) <> ''::text)))

checks.name: ck_tickets_status
checks.rule: ((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['OPEN'::character varying, 'TRIAGED'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying, 'RESOLVED'::character varying, 'CLOSED'::character varying])::text[]))

checks.name: ck_tickets_triaged_requirements
checks.rule: (((status)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['TRIAGED'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying])::text[])) OR ((category_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((priority)::text <> 'UNSET'::text) AND (assigned_team_id IS NOT NULL)))

tables.name: ticket_comments
tables.description: Public replies and technician-only internal notes on a ticket. Append-only: UPDATE and DELETE are rejected by a trigger (SD-021).

columns.name: comment_id
columns.meaning: Primary key.

columns.name: ticket_id
columns.meaning: Ticket commented on.

columns.name: author_id
columns.meaning: User who wrote the comment.

columns.name: body
columns.meaning: Comment text, nonblank.

columns.name: is_internal
columns.meaning: TRUE for technician-only notes, never shown to the requester.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Posting time (UTC).

tables.name: ticket_events
tables.description: Append-only audit trail: every mutation writes an event in the same transaction. UPDATE and DELETE are rejected by a trigger.

columns.name: event_id
columns.meaning: Primary key; tie-breaker for equal timestamps.

columns.name: ticket_id
columns.meaning: Ticket the event belongs to.

columns.name: actor_id
columns.meaning: Acting user; NULL means a system actor.

columns.name: event_type
columns.meaning: One of the approved event codes (see event catalogue).

columns.name: details
columns.meaning: JSON object with sanitized context (ids and values, never comment text or secrets).

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.meaning: Event time (UTC), database clock.

checks.name: ck_ticket_events_type
checks.rule: ((event_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['CREATED'::character varying, 'STATUS_CHANGED'::character varying, 'TEAM_ASSIGNED'::character varying, 'TEAM_REASSIGNED'::character varying, 'COMMENT_ADDED'::character varying, 'AI_REVIEWED'::character varying, 'RESOLVED'::character varying, 'REOPENED'::character varying, 'CATEGORY_UPDATED'::character varying, 'PRIORITY_UPDATED'::character varying, 'ASSIGNEE_UPDATED'::character varying])::text[]))

tables.name: ai_recommendations
tables.description: Immutable AI proposals plus the human review outcome. Proposals never overwrite approved ticket values.

columns.name: recommendation_id
columns.meaning: Primary key.

columns.name: ticket_id
columns.meaning: Ticket analysed.

columns.name: proposed_category_id
columns.meaning: AI-proposed category (original, never edited).

columns.name: proposed_team_id
columns.meaning: AI-proposed team (original).

columns.name: proposed_priority
columns.meaning: AI-proposed priority LOW..CRITICAL (original).

columns.name: suggestion
columns.meaning: AI troubleshooting suggestion text.

columns.name: confidence
columns.meaning: Model confidence 0..1, NUMERIC(4,3); not a calibrated probability.

columns.name: model_version
columns.meaning: Model/prompt version that produced it; nonblank.

columns.name: review_status
columns.meaning: PENDING, ACCEPTED, OVERRIDDEN or REJECTED.

columns.name: reviewer_id
columns.meaning: Technician who reviewed; required once reviewed, NULL while PENDING.

columns.name: reviewed_at
columns.meaning: Review time; required once reviewed, never before created_at.

columns.name: review_notes
columns.meaning: Optional reviewer comment.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: When the proposal was saved (UTC).

columns.name: job_id
columns.meaning: Analysis job (ai_analysis_jobs) that produced this recommendation (SD-036). UNIQUE, so one analysis attempt yields at most one row however often delivery is retried. NULL for rows not created by a job (fixtures, historical).

checks.name: ck_ai_recommendations_priority
checks.rule: ((proposed_priority IS NULL) OR ((proposed_priority)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['LOW'::character varying, 'MEDIUM'::character varying, 'HIGH'::character varying, 'CRITICAL'::character varying])::text[])))

checks.name: ck_ai_recommendations_review_complete
checks.rule: ((((review_status)::text = 'PENDING'::text) AND (reviewer_id IS NULL) AND (reviewed_at IS NULL)) OR (((review_status)::text <> 'PENDING'::text) AND (reviewer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)))

tables.name: knowledge_articles
tables.description: Troubleshooting articles searched by employees and linked from recommendations.

columns.name: article_id
columns.meaning: Primary key.

columns.name: category_id
columns.meaning: Optional category.

columns.name: title
columns.meaning: Article title (max 200), nonblank.

columns.name: body
columns.meaning: Article text, nonblank.

columns.name: is_published
columns.meaning: Only published articles are visible to employees.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Creation time (UTC).

columns.name: updated_at
columns.meaning: Last edit time, set by the service.

columns.name: search_revision
columns.meaning: Increments for changes to the published search projection, including unpublication.

tables.name: recommendation_articles
tables.description: Ranked knowledge articles attached to a recommendation (many-to-many).

columns.name: recommendation_id
columns.meaning: Part of the primary key.

columns.name: article_id
columns.meaning: Part of the primary key.

columns.name: relevance_rank
columns.meaning: Display order, 1 is most relevant; > 0 and unique per recommendation.

tables.name: classification_labels
tables.description: Independent reference category per ticket, used only to measure AI accuracy; never copied from AI output.

columns.name: ticket_id
columns.meaning: Primary key and foreign key: at most one label per ticket.

columns.name: reference_category_id
columns.meaning: Correct category as judged by the evaluator.

columns.name: labelled_by
columns.meaning: Evaluator (user) who assigned the label.

columns.name: labelled_at
columns.meaning: Labelling time (UTC).

tables.name: admin_audit_log
tables.description: Append-only audit trail of administrator account actions (SD-017): create, activate, deactivate, role change, password reset. UPDATE and DELETE are rejected by a trigger. Never holds credentials.

columns.name: audit_id
columns.meaning: Primary key.

columns.name: actor_id
columns.meaning: Administrator who performed the action.

columns.name: target_user_id
columns.meaning: Account the action was applied to.

columns.name: action
columns.meaning: USER_CREATED, USER_ACTIVATED, USER_DEACTIVATED, ROLE_CHANGED or PASSWORD_RESET.

columns.name: details
columns.meaning: JSON object with non-sensitive context, for example the previous and new role. Never a password, hash or token.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: When the action happened (UTC), database clock.

checks.name: ck_admin_audit_action
checks.rule: ((action)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['USER_CREATED'::character varying, 'USER_ACTIVATED'::character varying, 'USER_DEACTIVATED'::character varying, 'ROLE_CHANGED'::character varying, 'PASSWORD_RESET'::character varying])::text[]))

tables.name: ai_analysis_jobs
tables.description: Durable queue for AI ticket analysis (SD-035), a transactional outbox. A job is inserted in the same transaction as its ticket; workers claim rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and a time-limited lease, so work survives worker restarts and is never lost between ticket commit and dispatch. (ticket_id, request_id) is the idempotency key. Holds reason codes only, never ticket text, provider messages or secrets.

columns.name: job_id
columns.meaning: Primary key.

columns.name: ticket_id
columns.meaning: Ticket being analysed.

columns.name: request_id
columns.meaning: Analysis request identifier; with ticket_id it makes enqueueing idempotent. A re-analysis uses a new one.

columns.name: state
columns.meaning: QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED or FAILED.

columns.name: attempts
columns.meaning: Number of times the job has been claimed.

columns.name: max_attempts
columns.meaning: Claims allowed before the job fails terminally.

columns.name: run_after
columns.meaning: Earliest time the job may be claimed (retry backoff).

columns.name: lease_token
columns.meaning: Rotated on every claim; only the holder may complete or fail the job. NULL unless RUNNING.

columns.name: locked_until
columns.meaning: Lease expiry. A RUNNING job past this time is re-claimed. NULL unless RUNNING.

columns.name: error_kind
columns.meaning: Reason code of the latest failed attempt (for example timeout, rate_limited, malformed, internal, worker_lost). Never message text.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: When the job was queued.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.meaning: Last state change.

columns.name: completed_at
columns.meaning: When the job reached COMPLETED or FAILED; NULL otherwise.

checks.name: ck_ai_jobs_lease
checks.rule: (((state)::text = 'RUNNING'::text) = ((lease_token IS NOT NULL) AND (locked_until IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: ck_ai_jobs_terminal
checks.rule: (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['COMPLETED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying])::text[])) = (completed_at IS NOT NULL))

tables.name: notifications
tables.description: In-app employee notifications (SD-040). A row is inserted in the same transaction as the ticket event that caused it, so a rolled-back change leaves none and a committed one always has one. (recipient_id, event_id, type) is the deduplication key. Stores no message text: wording is derived from type and ticket when read, so internal notes and private details cannot leak. The recipient is the ticket requester, never the actor and never a deactivated account.

columns.name: notification_id
columns.meaning: Primary key.

columns.name: recipient_id
columns.meaning: Employee who sees the notification (the ticket requester).

columns.name: ticket_id
columns.meaning: Ticket the notification is about.

columns.name: event_id
columns.meaning: Audit event that produced it; with recipient and type it deduplicates.

columns.name: type
columns.meaning: TICKET_ASSIGNED, TICKET_STATUS_CHANGED, TICKET_RESOLVED, TICKET_REOPENED or TECHNICIAN_REPLY.

columns.name: read_at
columns.meaning: When the recipient marked it read; NULL while unread.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: When the notification was recorded.

checks.name: ck_notifications_type
checks.rule: ((type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['TICKET_ASSIGNED'::character varying, 'TICKET_STATUS_CHANGED'::character varying, 'TICKET_RESOLVED'::character varying, 'TICKET_REOPENED'::character varying, 'TECHNICIAN_REPLY'::character varying])::text[]))

tables.name: notification_deliveries
tables.description: Delivery queue for the optional email channel (SD-043). At most one row per notification (unique notification_id), so a notification is never queued or sent twice. The in-app notification exists and is complete before any delivery row does, so a disabled or failing mail server never affects tickets or the notification centre. Workers claim rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and a time-limited lease. Holds reason codes only, never addresses, message text or credentials.

columns.name: delivery_id
columns.meaning: Primary key.

columns.name: notification_id
columns.meaning: Notification being emailed; unique, so it is queued at most once.

columns.name: state
columns.meaning: QUEUED, RUNNING, SENT, FAILED or SKIPPED.

columns.name: attempts
columns.meaning: Number of times the delivery has been claimed.

columns.name: max_attempts
columns.meaning: Claims allowed before the delivery fails terminally.

columns.name: run_after
columns.meaning: Earliest time the delivery may be claimed (retry backoff).

columns.name: lease_token
columns.meaning: Rotated on every claim; only the holder may finish or fail the delivery. NULL unless RUNNING.

columns.name: locked_until
columns.meaning: Lease expiry. A RUNNING delivery past this time is re-claimed. NULL unless RUNNING.

columns.name: error_kind
columns.meaning: Reason code of the latest failure or skip (for example temporary, unavailable, rate_limited, auth_failed, rejected, already_read, expired). Never message text.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: When the delivery was queued.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.meaning: Last state change.

columns.name: completed_at
columns.meaning: When the delivery reached SENT, FAILED or SKIPPED; NULL otherwise.

checks.name: ck_notification_deliveries_lease
checks.rule: (((state)::text = 'RUNNING'::text) = ((lease_token IS NOT NULL) AND (locked_until IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: ck_notification_deliveries_state
checks.rule: ((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['QUEUED'::character varying, 'RUNNING'::character varying, 'SENT'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'SKIPPED'::character varying])::text[]))

checks.name: ck_notification_deliveries_terminal
checks.rule: (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SENT'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'SKIPPED'::character varying])::text[])) = (completed_at IS NOT NULL))

tables.name: search_index_jobs
tables.description: PostgreSQL outbox for ticket and published knowledge search (SD-076). Source changes and jobs commit together. Each entity revision has at most one job. The queue stores IDs and indexing intent, without document content.

columns.name: job_id
columns.meaning: Primary key.

columns.name: entity_type
columns.meaning: TICKET or KNOWLEDGE_ARTICLE.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.meaning: Source entity UUID. Jobs can outlive a source row.

columns.name: revision
columns.meaning: Monotonic ticket version or knowledge search revision.

columns.name: event_kind
columns.meaning: UPSERT reconciles a searchable source. DELETE removes a document.

columns.name: state
columns.meaning: QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED or FAILED.

columns.name: attempts
columns.meaning: Number of times the job has been claimed.

columns.name: max_attempts
columns.meaning: Maximum claims before terminal failure.

columns.name: available_at
columns.meaning: Earliest time a queued job can be claimed.

columns.name: lease_token
columns.meaning: Claim token. Only present while RUNNING.

columns.name: locked_until
columns.meaning: Lease expiry for a RUNNING job.

columns.name: error_kind
columns.meaning: Bounded failure reason code.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: When the source change queued the job.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.meaning: When the job state last changed.

columns.name: completed_at
columns.meaning: When the job reached COMPLETED or FAILED.

checks.name: ck_search_index_jobs_lease
checks.rule: ((((state)::text = 'RUNNING'::text) = (lease_token IS NOT NULL)) AND (((state)::text = 'RUNNING'::text) = (locked_until IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: ck_search_index_jobs_terminal
checks.rule: (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['COMPLETED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying])::text[])) = (completed_at IS NOT NULL))
